subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: Should a timed-out group-chat membership lookup fail the file send, or continue using the existing organization-wide sharing fallback?
rationale: The patch adds a deterministic route into a broader-access fallback; choosing whether availability or least-privilege sharing wins is a security and product boundary automation should not settle.

options.title: Fail closed on timeout
options.body: Rethrow timeout and transport failures while preserving organization fallback only for explicitly accepted permission-related cases.

options.title: Keep organization fallback
options.body: Accept that a slow or unavailable membership lookup may create an organization-wide link so file delivery can continue.

options.title: Pause both timeout PRs
options.body: Hold both timeout PRs until one canonical timeout and fallback policy is agreed for all Teams SharePoint paths.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on timeout
recommendation.body: Rethrow timeout and transport failures while preserving organization fallback only for explicitly accepted permission-related cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent MS Teams file-consent security hardening makes this the strongest available owner for the least-privilege fallback decision.
